Our Approach

Montessori, practiced the way it was meant to be.

Every shelf, chair, and material in our home is sized, sequenced, and placed for one purpose: to let a child do things for themselves, at their own pace, without being rushed or rescued.

Independence First

Children pour, sweep, dress, and choose their own work — building real self-reliance, one small success at a time.

Hands-On Discovery

Concepts in math, language, and science are felt in the hands first — abstraction comes only once it's earned.

Respect for the Child

We observe before we intervene. Every guide follows the child's interest rather than a fixed lesson plan.

Prepared Environment

Low shelves, child-sized tools, and one material of each kind — a home built entirely to the child's scale.

Meet Our Founder

Mrs. Sohaila Zoheir

“Every child deserves a prepared, gentle space to discover who they are — at their own pace, in their own time.”

Mrs. Sohaila Zoheir founded Montessori Child Home to bring an authentic, home-like Montessori experience to families in Alexandria — one built on patience, respect, and real trust in the child. Her approach blends traditional Montessori pedagogy with a positive-discipline philosophy, shaping a classroom culture where children feel safe, capable, and genuinely heard.

  • Classroom Director Diploma in Early Childhood Education, Ages 3–6 — Montessori Educational Programs International (MEPI)
  • Certified Positive Discipline Classroom Educator — Positive Discipline Association (PDA)
  • Certified Positive Discipline Parent Educator — Positive Discipline Association (PDA)
  • Comprehensive Child & Adolescent Psychological Counseling Diploma (150 Hours) — Sound of Child Association & Masar Center
  • Practical Training Certificate in Child & Adolescent Psychological Counseling — Masar Center
  • “Together in Peace” Workshop Certificate — Montessori Egyptian Center
  • Over 8 years of experience in early childhood education, parenting, and child counseling.
  • Along with numerous specialized courses and training workshops in child development and positive behavior management.
Programs

Two communities, one continuous journey.

Children stay with the same mixed-age community for years, so younger ones learn by watching and older ones lead by teaching.

18 months – 3 years

Toddler Community

A gentle first step away from home — language-rich, movement-heavy, and centered on toilet learning, self-care, and first words.

  • Practical life & self-care routines
  • Sensorial exploration & fine motor work
  • Language immersion through songs & stories
3 – 6 years

Primary Community (Casa)

The classic Montessori "Children's House" — a full three-hour uninterrupted work cycle across practical life, sensorial, math, language, and culture.

  • Full Montessori material curriculum
  • Mixed-age peer teaching & leadership
  • Arabic, English & enrichment sessions
A Day Here

A rhythm children can set their own clock to.

Predictable, unhurried, and led by an uninterrupted block of work each morning — the heart of every Montessori day.

7:30

Arrival & Free Choice

Children settle in and choose their first piece of work from the shelf.

9:00

Circle Time

Songs, calendar, and a shared moment as a community.

9:30

The Work Cycle

An uninterrupted stretch of self-directed, hands-on learning.

11:30

Garden Time

Outdoor movement, sand, water, and real gardening tools.

12:15

Lunch & Rest

A family-style meal, followed by quiet rest or reading.

2:00

Afternoon Enrichment

Music, art, or movement before pickup begins.

Why Families Choose Us

A small home, not a big institution.

  • AMI/AMS-trained guides

    Every lead teacher is credentialed in authentic Montessori pedagogy, not a weekend certificate.

  • Small, mixed-age groups

    Capped ratios keep every child seen — never lost in a crowd of thirty.

  • Real partnership with families

    Termly conferences and an open-door policy — you're part of the classroom, not outside it.

The Red Rods — teaching length, order, and visual discrimination through touch.
